subject: 英語
stem: 本文の内容として正しいものを1つ選びなさい。
passage: Last summer, Kenta visited his grandfather in Hokkaido. His grandfather has a small farm and grows potatoes and corn. Every morning, Kenta got up at five and helped him on the farm. It was hard work, but Kenta enjoyed it very much. One day, his grandfather said, "Farming is not easy, but I love it because I can grow food for many people." Kenta was moved by these words. Before he went home, he decided to study science at high school. He wanted to learn how to grow better vegetables. Now he reads many books about plants every day.
choices: Kenta helped his grandfather on the farm every morning.
Kenta's grandfather grows rice and tomatoes on his farm.
Kenta got up at seven every morning in Hokkaido.
Kenta thought the farm work was too hard to enjoy.
explanation: 【単元】長文読解。正解は「Kenta helped his grandfather on the farm every morning.」。本文に「Every morning, Kenta got up at five and helped him on the farm」とあるので、毎朝手伝ったが正しいです。育てているのはpotatoesとcorn、起きたのは五時、そして仕事を楽しんだと書かれています。

subject: 英語
stem: 本文の内容として正しいものを1つ選びなさい。
passage: Emma is a student from Australia. She came to Japan two years ago and now goes to a junior high school in Osaka. At first, she could not speak Japanese well, so she was worried about making friends. However, her classmates were very kind to her. They talked to her slowly and taught her useful words. One girl, Aya, became her best friend. They eat lunch together every day. Emma says, "Learning Japanese is difficult, but my friends help me a lot. I want to work in Japan in the future." She practices Japanese with Aya after school.
choices: Emma's classmates were kind and taught her useful words.
Emma could speak Japanese well when she came to Japan.
Emma came to Japan from Australia five years ago.
Emma eats lunch alone because she has no friends.
explanation: 【単元】長文読解。正解は「Emma's classmates were kind and taught her useful words.」。本文に「her classmates were very kind to her. They talked to her slowly and taught her useful words」とあります。来日は二年前で、最初は日本語をうまく話せませんでした。

subject: 英語
stem: 本文の内容として正しいものを1つ選びなさい。
passage: Our town has a beautiful river. When my mother was a child, the water was very clean, and many fish lived there. But some years ago, people threw plastic bottles and bags into the river, and it became dirty. Last year, our school started a project to clean it. Every month, students and teachers pick up the trash along the river. Many people in the town joined us, too. Now the river is getting cleaner, and we can see small fish again. I am happy because I could do something good for my town. I hope everyone keeps the river clean.
choices: Students and teachers pick up the trash by the river every month.
The river has always been dirty since my mother was a child.
Only students clean the river, and no one else helps them.
The school started the project ten years ago.
explanation: 【単元】長文読解。正解は「Students and teachers pick up the trash by the river every month.」。本文に「Every month, students and teachers pick up the trash along the river」とあります。母が子どものころは川はきれいで、町の人も手伝い、活動は昨年始まりました。
